release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.15 uses the extra Sidebar space created by the ten-workspace navigation to add a dedicated owner Announcements Hub directly below Owner Vault. Owner Vault remains a fixed lower-rail card while the new announcement composer flex-fills the remaining Sidebar space. Authorized owner/admin sessions with broadcasts.write can enter a title and message, choose Info, Release, Maintenance, or Warning, choose dismissible behavior, and send live to members directly from the Sidebar. The hub reuses the existing protected /api/owner/broadcasts pipeline so capability checks, audit behavior, signed member policy, live popup/history delivery, and the existing announcement system remain unchanged. The composer stays hidden from standard members and in collapsed-sidebar mode rather than compressing into the narrow rail. Regression coverage protects layout, authority gating, payload compatibility, and composition after the ten-tab navigation. The merged patch passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight, Windows Consumer E2E including the native Go tests, EXE build, protected runtime and real Wails/WebView2 shell, and CodeQL before Stable promotion.
